title: Shame that the print says Brut
text: Shame that the print says Brut. Slightly waxed on the inside and great to store brioche bread or any enriched bread.  The other bag wouldn’t fit anything with height.  Small loaves are acceptable.  What was disappointing was that it doesn’t say Bread; instead the print says ‘Brut’.  Not something to be used on a professional setting given the print, but okay for personal use or gifting baked goodies to family and friends.
